title: Quick Tip: Business Central Launch Event 2025 Wave 2: 47 Must-Watch Videos
summary: The Business Central Launch Event compilation showcases 47 videos covering new features across AI, e-commerce, e-documents, sustainability, analytics, development, and finance. These resources help administrators, developers, and end users understand the latest Wave 2 innovations with hands-on demonstrations and guidance from Microsoft experts.
key_points: 47 videos totaling over 8 hours of content covering all functional areas
Major focus on Copilot and AI integration for automation and decision-making
Comprehensive coverage of e-documents, ZUGFeRD compliance, and digital transformation
Sustainability features including CSRD reporting and emissions tracking
Enhanced analytics with Power BI apps and financial compliance tools

quotes.text: The AI revolution in Business Central isn't just about automation - it's about empowering users to make better decisions faster.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the strategic value of Copilot integration beyond process automation

quotes.text: Environmental responsibility is no longer optional.
